choices: A single String with all file content
A List<String> where each element is one line
A byte[] of the raw file bytes
A Scanner ready to read the file
explanation: Files.readAllLines() reads the entire file and returns each line as a String in a List. Convenient for small files. For large files, use Files.lines() which returns a lazy Stream<String> that reads line by line without loading everything into memory at once.
